OEM-ODM DEVELOPMENT

Five Steps.
One Engineering Partner.

Each project moves through a clear sequence, with engineering support at every critical decision.

01 · ACOUSTIC ENGINEERING

Define the Sound Target

We translate your application into measurable targets including frequency response, sensitivity, impedance, power handling and low-frequency performance.

02 · MECHANICAL DESIGN

Fit the Product System

Dimensions, mounting points, enclosure volume, installation structure and appearance are developed around your finished product.

03 · MATERIAL SELECTION

Balance Sound and Reliability

We select diaphragm, voice-coil, magnet, suspension and frame materials to match the intended performance and operating environment.

04 · TESTING & VALIDATION

Validate Before Scale-Up

Prototype samples are tuned and verified for acoustic targets, system fit and reliability before the production specification is confirmed.

05 · PRODUCTION OPTIMIZATION

Build for Consistency

We define the production process and control points for repeatable small-batch programs and confident scale-up.

IDEAL FOR NEW PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

Validate First.
Scale With Confidence.

Our flexible manufacturing model is designed for multi-model, small-batch programs. It gives product teams a practical path to test a new idea, refine the sound and scale only when the market is ready.
